title: Sweet Chilli Peppers with Tomato

media.caption: Open the chilli peppers and remove the seeds
Put them in a pan with plenty of olive oil and a few cloves of garlic
Remove the garlic and add the chopped tomatoes
Cook for 5 minutes over medium heat
Keep the pan covered at all times

healthBenefits.title: Rich in Vitamin C
healthBenefits.text: Sweet chilli peppers are exceptionally high in vitamin C, supporting immune function and collagen production.

healthBenefits.title: Antioxidant Lycopene
healthBenefits.text: Ripe tomatoes provide lycopene, an antioxidant linked to reduced risk of heart disease and certain cancers.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil supplies monounsaturated fats that help maintain healthy cholesterol levels.

healthBenefits.title: Immune Support
healthBenefits.text: Garlic contains allicin, a compound with antimicrobial and immune-boosting properties.

healthBenefits.title: Metabolism Boost
healthBenefits.text: Capsaicin in chilli peppers may help increase metabolic rate and reduce inflammation.

healthBenefits.title: Low Calorie, Nutrient Dense
healthBenefits.text: This dish is naturally low in calories while being rich in vitamins, fibre, and antioxidants.

_ingredientsText:
20 sweet green chilli peppers
5 ripe tomatoes
1 clove of garlic
2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
salt
a pinch of hot chilli pepper and basil (optional)
_preparationText:
1 - Aprire i peperoni e eliminare i semi
2 - Tagliarli in piccoli tocchi
3 - Versarli in una padella con abbondante olio e alcuni spicchi di aglio
4 - Iniziare la cottura girando spesso
5 - Togliere l'aglio e aggiungere dei pomodori a tocchi
6 - Cucinare per 5 minuti a fuoco medio
7 - Tenere sempre coperta la padella
8 - aggiungere il sale
